# Prospect — export column map

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m gtm_core.prospects schema-doc`. Do not hand-edit:
     re-run the command instead. Held in sync by
     tests/contracts/test_hubspot_csv_map_sync.py. -->

One row per **contact**, not per account: a Tier-A account with 2 enriched
contacts is 2 rows. Written as `prospects-YYYYMMDD-hubspot.csv`, and folded into
the pool by `python -m gtm_core.prospects consolidate`.

The **CSV Column** below is the header to write. Any listed alias is accepted, so
an older export keeps importing; the first spelling is the one to write today.

## Columns a run writes

| CSV Column | Also accepted | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `First Name` | `first` | given name; a blank one is held back by the merge-field gate |
| `Last Name` | `last` | family name |
| `Email` | `Contact Email`, `email` | the dedup key for the export; blank if unverified, never guessed |
| `Job Title` | `Contact Title`, `title` | job title, as the source gave it |
| `Company Name` | `Company`, `company` | company name, cleaned of research-note artifacts |
| `Company Domain Name` | `company_domain` | the company's own domain, e.g. `example.com` |
| `City` | `HQ City`, `city` | HQ city — cross-examined against `country` by the compliance gate |
| `Country/Region` | `Market`, `country` | HQ country, full name |
| `GTM_Segment` | `Segment`, `segment` | `Enterprise` / `Startup` |
| `GTM_Tier` | `Tier`, `tier` | `A` / `B` |
| `GTM_Score` | `Score`, `Lead Score`, `score` | numeric, no denominator |
| `conf` | — | source-reported confidence, if any |
| `Email Status` | `email_status` | deliverability signal (RocketReach grade, `verified`, ...) |
| `GTM_Why_Now` | `Why Now`, `why_now` | the research note behind the opener |
| `GTM_Case_Study` | `Case Study`, `case_study` | the matched reference customer |
| `GTM_Heat` | `Heat`, `heat` | intent heat, 0-3 |
| `GTM_Top_Intent_Score` | `top_intent_score` | raw 0-100 topic-intent score behind `heat` |
| `GTM_Intent_Topics` | `Intent Topics`, `intent_topics` | `topic:score` pairs, highest first, semicolon-joined |
| `GTM_Persona_Tier` | `Cohort`, `cohort` | ICP cohort this account was scored under |
| `GTM_Qualification_Path` | `Qualification Path`, `qualification_path` | set only when a gate was relaxed for the run |
| `GTM_Signal_Source_URL` | `Signal Source URL`, `signal_source_url` | primary source for the why-now — https, re-fetchable |
| `GTM_Signal_Observed` | `Signal Observed`, `signal_observed` | ISO date the source showed it (freshness lives here, not in the clause) |
| `GTM_Signal_Evidence` | `Signal Evidence`, `signal_evidence` | verbatim span of the source the clause reduces |
| `GTM_Signal_Subject` | `Signal Subject`, `signal_subject` | the entity the fact is ABOUT; not this company means the row is wrong |
| `GTM_Signal_Agent_Kind` | `Signal Agent Kind`, `signal_agent_kind` | `ai` | `human` | `none` | `unclear` — whose 'agents' the clause means |
| `GTM_Category_Relation` | `Category Relation`, `category_relation` | `prospect` | `competitor` | `partner` | `adjacent` | `regulator` |
| `GTM_Verdict` | `Verdict`, `verdict` | `send` | `re-angle` | `drop` — the RESEARCHER's, never machine-overwritten |
| `GTM_Verdict_Reason` | `Verdict Reason`, `verdict_reason` | required for any non-send verdict |
| `GTM_Signal_Column` | `Signal Column`, `signal_column` | the hook-matrix signal this row's own why-now attests |

## Columns the pipeline assigns

Do not write these — a value supplied here is overwritten, and for the judge
columns an input that claimed to be judged would be believed by nothing.

| Column | Assigned by |
|---|---|
| `src` | set from the export's own filename |
| `conf_tier` | derived from email_status/conf by `classify_confidence` |
| `suppression` | re-derived from the suppression ledger on every sweep |
| `suppression_date` | re-derived from the suppression ledger on every sweep |
| `judge_verdict` | written by the judge; an input claiming to be judged is not |
| `judge_verdict_reason` | written by the judge |
| `judge_calibrated` | written by the judge, from the profile's sealed holdouts |
| `pool_row_id` | stamped once by consolidate; never supplied |
| `account_id` | stamped by latest.json, joined here; never supplied |

## The record is not optional

`signal_source_url`, `signal_observed`, `signal_evidence`, `signal_subject`,
`signal_agent_kind`, `category_relation`, `verdict` and `verdict_reason` are what
make a row checkable. Without them a renamed company, a fact about the wrong
entity, and a number that drifted from its source are undetectable by
construction — see `gtm_core/signal_record.py`. The enrollment gate blocks a list
that lacks them.

Resolve any path this file mentions with:

```bash
uv run python -m gtm_core.prospects paths --profile <active>
```
